title: Path of Exile 2 0.4.0 Fate of the Vaal & Atziri Temple: Beacons, Rooms and the 0.4.0d/e Fixes
summary: How the 0.4.0 Fate of the Vaal league built a multi-room Atziri Temple, why rooms disconnected or destabilised at launch, and what 0.4.0d and 0.4.0e changed for the current rules.
description: A mechanism history of Fate of the Vaal and the buildable Atziri Temple: Beacons, Energy, room placement and upgrades, the Architect/Atziri/Chambers/Vault relationship, the 0.4.0d connection fixes and the 0.4.0e removal of automatic Destabilisation.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Atziri, the Red Queen, final boss of the rebuilt Temple

cards.detail: Beacons are placed in the Temple area and consume Energy to construct rooms. Their placement determines which rooms connect.
Earned from cleared rooms and league activities; gates how many rooms you can build and upgrade.
Each room has a function (reward, hazard, boss antechamber). Connectivity was the launch-week pain point.
Chambers gate the Vault; the Vault leads to Atziri, the Red Queen.

bosses.name: The Architect
bosses.detail: Builds and defends Temple rooms. After 0.4.0e its pacing was tuned so it is a threat, not a run-ender.
bosses.action: Treat as pacing threat; do not over-invest in anti-bricking plans.

bosses.name: Atziri, the Red Queen
bosses.detail: Final boss reached through the Vault. Her identity is unchanged, but arena access follows post-0.4.0d connection rules.
bosses.action: Update access guides to current connection rules.

bosses.name: Vaal-touched rares
bosses.detail: Corrupting modifiers inside Temple rooms; part of the league's risk/reward.
bosses.action: Map under Endgame/Temple, not a separate league.

items.title: Orb of Sacrifice
items.detail: Central to Temple crafting and Vaal-corruption workflows introduced with the league.

items.title: Vaal Orb
items.detail: Its corrupting role is consistent with earlier behaviour, promoted alongside the Vaal storyline.

items.title: Talisman
items.detail: Shapeshift weapon base introduced in the same 0.4.0 window; frequently drops in Vaal content.

changes.title: Room connection logic
changes.detail: 0.4.0d rewrote how placed rooms connect, reducing unreachable rooms and dead-end paths.

changes.title: Death-retry flow
changes.detail: Improved feedback and retry after death inside the Temple so a wipe did not silently corrupt room state.

changes.title: Map-state feedback
changes.detail: Added clearer indicators for which rooms were connected versus pending.

changes.title: Removed automatic Destabilisation
changes.detail: 0.4.0e deleted the auto-Destabilisation that could brick a Temple without warning; rooms now only destabilise after explicit warnings.

changes.title: Architect pacing
changes.detail: Tuned Architect pressure after Destabilisation was removed so the league kept tension without run-ending randomness.

changes.title: Temple UI warnings
changes.detail: Added explicit warnings before a room destabilises, replacing the silent auto-brick.

rows.thenText: 0.4.0 launch: rooms frequently disconnected or became unreachable.
rows.nowText: 0.4.0d connection logic keeps rooms reachable; map feedback is explicit.

rows.thenText: 0.4.0 launch: Temple could auto-destabilise with no warning.
0.4.0 launch: a death could silently corrupt room state.
rows.nowText: 0.4.0d retry flow preserves state and gives clear feedback.

rows.currentSummary: Core Temple loop unchanged in identity; build rooms with Beacons spending Energy.
0.4.0d rewrote connectivity; later map updates may have adjusted further.
Removed in 0.4.0e; rooms no longer auto-brick.
Atziri remains the Temple's final boss in 0.5.4e.

reports.context: Players reported unreachable rooms and silent destabilisation.
reports.quote: Half my Temple was unreachable and then it destabilised with no warning.
reports.analysis: Matches launch behaviour; 0.4.0d fixed connectivity and 0.4.0e removed auto-Destabilisation. Current runs should not show this.

reports.quote: Now I actually get a warning before a room goes.
reports.analysis: Confirms 0.4.0e behaviour is live; use post-0.4.0e guides.

issues.text: A room shows 'pending' and will not connect — verify Beacon placement and Energy; this is expected pre-connection, not a bug.
Atziri unreachable — confirm Chamber routing follows post-0.4.0d connection rules, not launch-week paths.
Legacy videos show auto-Destabilisation — those are pre-0.4.0e and do not reflect current rules.

rows.name: Atziri Temple guide
rows.action: Rewrite connection and retry sections; remove auto-Destabilisation.
